marketplace_installations_uninstall_comp.name: marketplace_installations_uninstall_complete
marketplace_installations_uninstall_comp.value: ("marketplace_installations"."uninstalled_at" IS NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstalled_by" IS NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstall_idempotency_key" IS NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstall_request_digest" IS NULL) OR ("marketplace_installations"."uninstalled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstalled_by" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstall_idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "marketplace_installations"."uninstall_request_digest" IS NOT NULL)

retention_holds_scope_shape_check.name: retention_holds_scope_shape_check
retention_holds_scope_shape_check.value: ("retention_holds"."scope_kind" = 'class' and "retention_holds"."workspace_id" is null and "retention_holds"."project_id" is null) or ("retention_holds"."scope_kind" = 'workspace' and "retention_holds"."workspace_id" is not null and "retention_holds"."project_id" is null) or ("retention_holds"."scope_kind" = 'project' and "retention_holds"."workspace_id" is not null and "retention_holds"."project_id" is not null)

retention_holds_release_revision_check.name: retention_holds_release_revision_check
retention_holds_release_revision_check.value: ("retention_holds"."revision" = 0 and "retention_holds"."release_request_id" is null and "retention_holds"."released_at" is null and "retention_holds"."released_by_principal_ref" is null and "retention_holds"."release_authority_ref" is null) or ("retention_holds"."revision" = 1 and "retention_holds"."release_request_id" is not null and "retention_holds"."released_at" is not null and "retention_holds"."released_by_principal_ref" is not null and "retention_holds"."release_authority_ref" is not null)

retired_command_keys_metadata_check.name: retired_command_keys_metadata_check
retired_command_keys_metadata_check.value: ("retired_command_keys"."metadata_version" = 1 and "retired_command_keys"."identity_digest" is null) or ("retired_command_keys"."metadata_version" = 2 and "retired_command_keys"."identity_digest" is not null and "retired_command_keys"."identity_digest" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

runtime_connections_location_check.name: runtime_connections_location_check
runtime_connections_location_check.value: ("runtime_connections"."connection_type" = 'managed_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."location" = 'agent_hq_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."runtime_node_ref_id" is null) or ("runtime_connections"."connection_type" <> 'managed_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."location" = 'local_device' and "runtime_connections"."runtime_node_ref_id" is not null)

runtime_node_issued_credentials_claims_s.name: runtime_node_issued_credentials_claims_scope_check
runtime_node_issued_credentials_claims_s.value:
jsonb_typeof("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims") = 'object'
        and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'credentialKind' = 'runtime_node'
        and ("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'schemaVersion')::integer = 1
        and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'credentialId' = "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."credential_id"
        and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'nodeId' = "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."node_id"
        and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'workspaceId' = "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."workspace_id"
        and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'keyId' = "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."key_id"

runtime_node_issued_credentials_revocati.name: runtime_node_issued_credentials_revocation_state_check
runtime_node_issued_credentials_revocati.value:
("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."revoked_at" is null
          and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."revocation_version" = ("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'revocationVersion')::bigint)
        or ("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null
          and "runtime_node_issued_credentials"."revocation_version" = ("runtime_node_issued_credentials"."claims" ->> 'revocationVersion')::bigint + 1)

tool_calls_identity_check.name: tool_calls_identity_check
tool_calls_identity_check.value: jsonb_typeof("tool_calls"."call") = 'object' and "tool_calls"."call"->>'toolCallId' = "tool_calls"."tool_call_id" and "tool_calls"."call"->>'workspaceId' = "tool_calls"."workspace_id" and "tool_calls"."call"->>'idempotencyKey' = "tool_calls"."idempotency_key" and "tool_calls"."call"->>'executionId' = "tool_calls"."execution_id" and ("tool_calls"."call"->>'revision')::bigint = "tool_calls"."revision"
